description: Reads construction-stage analysis results the way the Construction Stage Reporter plugin does (POST /post/TABLE in the construction-stage family, every stage in one query at its last step; stages after the analysis stopped carry the stage before and are flagged published:false). displacements (default on): per stage the largest resultant |D| over all nodes, its node and DX/DY/DZ, in mm; nodes:[ids] adds those nodes' displacements per stage. members: beam forces or stresses of chosen beams — per stage the max/min of a component over the beams active in it, with element, output position (I…J) and section part; detailElements:[ids] (≤20) adds the values along those beams. Units are the model's (forces/moments) and mm (displacements). series is a construction-stage result series (default Summation; listSeries: true lists what the model publishes, e.g. Dead Load, Tendon Primary, Creep Secondary). Needs a construction-stage analysis already run in CIVIL NX. Read-only; may take a minute on big models.

listSeries.description: Also list the construction-stage series the model publishes.

members.description: Beam results of chosen members: {groups:[structure group names]} and/or {elements:[ids]} (only TYPE BEAM elements count), table 'BEAMFORCE' (default) or 'BEAMSTRESS', component (default Moment-y for forces, Cb(min/max) for stresses; heads such as Axial, Shear-z, Moment-y, Bend(+z), Cb1(-y+z), or short names My, Mz, Fx, Fz), part 'gov' (default: on composite members the governing section part at each position) or 1–4 (1 = girder, 2 = slab), series (default Summation). Composite members' stresses are read per section part (COMPSECTBEAMSTRESS), as the plugin does.

components.description: Several components at once (instead of component).

nodes.description: Node ids whose displacements to list per stage.

series.description: Construction-stage result series for the displacements.

stages.description: Stage names to report (default: every stage).

name: cs_stage_results
title: Construction Stage Reporter — construction-stage results
